title: CISA Catalog of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Twilio Authy contains an information disclosure vulnerability in its API that allows an unauthenticated endpoint to accept a request containing a phone number and respond with information about whether the phone number was registered with Authy.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted web site that triggers access to an object that (1) was not properly allocated or (2) is deleted, as demonstrated by a CDwnBindInfo object.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: The impacted product is end-of-life and should be disconnected if still in use.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) Insecure Default Password Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) allows an unauthenticated user to execute commands remotely due to the use of default passwords.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: VMware ESXi contains an authentication bypass vulnerability. A malicious actor with sufficient Active Directory (AD) permissions can gain full access to an ESXi host that was previously configured to use AD for user management by re-creating the configured AD group ('ESXi Admins' by default) after it was deleted from AD.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
